description: Delete the old spatial-index-repair directory and create the new lattice-propagation-repair directory structure with all required files implementing 7 interacting bugs across a lattice signal propagation simulator.
steps: Delete the /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/spatial-index-repair directory entirely
Delete /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/spatial-index-repair.zip if it exists
Create directory /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/data/
Create directory /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/solution/
Create directory /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/tests/

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/Dockerfile with FROM ghcr.io/laude-institute/t-bench/python-3.11-uv:latest, COPY runtime/ /app/runtime/, WORKDIR /app, and # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY
Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/__init__.py with package docstring and # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/config.ini with simulation parameters (time_step=0.001, sampling_rate=1000, bandpass_low=50, bandpass_high=200, window_size=64, propagation_speed=343.0) and # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/data/topology.json - 7 node directed graph where some paths are 1-2 hops and others are 4-5 hops. Edges have weight (attenuation in dB) and delay (seconds). Design so bugs 2 and 5 only manifest on long paths. Include // PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY in a comment field.

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/data/trace_001.json - signal injection at node 0, frequency 100Hz sinusoid + noise, 500 samples at 1000Hz sampling rate. Include _canary field.

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/data/trace_002.json - signal injection at node 3, frequency 150Hz sinusoid + noise, 500 samples. Include _canary field.

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/data/trace_003.json - signal injection at node 5, frequency 80Hz sinusoid + noise, 500 samples. Include _canary field.

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/propagation_core.py with: (1) Bug 1 - attenuation uses ln() going in but log10() coming out of log domain, (2) Bug 2 - phase modulo 2pi applied BEFORE adding current hop phase instead of after. Include red herring: a complex but correct Doppler correction function. Include # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY.

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/lattice_analysis.py with: (3) Bug 3 - sin/cos swapped in phasor addition (uses cos for imaginary, sin for real), (4) Bug 4 - energy normalization divides by window_size instead of actual sample count at boundaries. Include red herring: correct but complex spectral leakage compensation. Include # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY.

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/topology_resolver.py with: (5) Bug 5 - DFS visited set not restored on early-return when node has exactly one outgoing edge to target. Include correct complex cycle detection as red herring. Include # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY.

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/signal_filter.py with: (6) Bug 6 - biquad bandpass uses sampling_rate instead of sampling_rate/2 (Nyquist) in frequency pre-warping. Include correct but complex filter cascade composition as red herring. Include # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY.

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/calibration.py with: (7) Bug 7 - timestamp quantization uses floor() instead of round(). Only matters when two signals arrive within half a time step. Include correct but complex jitter compensation as red herring. Include # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY.

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/aggregator.py - correct module that aggregates per-node results into synthesis report. No bugs. Include # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY.

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/environment/runtime/pipeline.py - main entry point that orchestrates: load topology, load traces, resolve paths, propagate signals, filter, compute interference, calibrate timing, aggregate, write synthesis report to /app/runtime/output/synthesis_report.json. Include # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY.

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/instruction.md with vague problem description, absolute paths only (/app/runtime/...), no enumeration of individual bugs, mentions anomalies in synthesis report. Must contain <!-- PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY -->.
Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/task.toml with metadata as specified in the requirements. Must contain # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY.
Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/tests/test.sh that runs pipeline then pytest. Must contain # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY.

Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/tests/test_lattice_propagation.py with ~15-20 assertions validating synthesis report end-to-end (per-node energy levels, propagation delays, interference magnitudes, resonance detection). Must contain # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY.
Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/solution/solve.sh that runs repair script. Must contain # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY.
Create /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/lattice-propagation-repair/solution/repair_lattice.py that patches all 7 bugs via string replacement, then re-runs pipeline. Must contain # PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY.
Update /projects/sandbox/plutu-lucky/.gitignore to reference lattice-propagation-repair instead of spatial-index-repair
acceptance_criteria: All files in lattice-propagation-repair contain PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY
instruction.md uses only absolute paths starting with /app/
pipeline.py runs without import errors and produces synthesis_report.json (with buggy values)
repair_lattice.py successfully patches all 7 bugs via string replacement

Before repair, tests fail on at least some assertions
topology.json creates paths of varying length (1-5 hops) to trigger different bug subsets

Run: grep -r 'PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY' lattice-propagation-repair/ | wc -l  (should match number of files)
